Kalmia Mission ControlClass 13 · Worth it, ready, signed · learning game (not graded)

Your mission: make Kalmia worth it, ready and signed.

Kalmia Coffee Roasters Inc. has twelve risks, twenty-six possible measures and $20,000 a year. Four missions teach you to judge a measure by the level of its risk and by its money (L1), to keep the business running through a ransomware night (L2), to know what is left and who may sign for it (L3), and to build the plan the CEO (chief executive officer) will defend (L4).

Every mission: Why? (first principles) → Build it (play with the real numbers) → lecture, slides and notes → cards → quiz → videos and sources. XP and badges stay in this browser.

💡 A measure is kept when it fits the level of the risk and is worth its cost; the risk that remains is accepted by a manager who signs, never by the analyst.
